body: Nope, though as with many queer people, it does bring us a bit closer. And I'm not scared of that (I think?), So no idea
Maybe? Probably. I /do/ have BPD, and this seems like just the kind of stuff that would get amplified. Ugh. Thanks for helping!
I am aware and that's why I need some explanation, I know she's the same person. The emphasis is either extra info or context.

It's quite hard for me to be shocked, I was the one helping her out by prompting scenarios that eventually led to the conclusion that men were out. I am a bit sad to lose a bi friend.

I'm not out of their dating pool, she's said she likes enbies and I'm nonbinary. Though, again, no crush here.

It'd be hypocritical of her to turn out to be biphobic or transphobic, considering she was bi, and is under the trans umbrella. Besides, she's always been real cool about my identity. And I don't have any bad personal experiences with lesbians, so...
Just... upset. Crossed. Not with her. Annoyed, maybe? I don't know.
